name: Pa pinh top
summary: Thái grilled fish. Bảo tàng tỉnh Sơn La calls it stream fish, split along the back, stuffed with ginger, lemongrass, and mắc khén, clamped on a bamboo stick, and eaten with xôi nếp. Vietnam.vn, on 2 April 2024, names carp, trôi, or trắm, and adds herbs, hạt dổi, sa nhân shoots, galangal powder, and toasted rice powder. Báo Sơn La, on 4 September 2020, keeps the organs, removes the gall, and uses carp, trôi, trắm, or rô phi, with fresh chili, cilantro, onion, and mint. Vietnamnet, on 16 March 2019, adds mương and calls the taste hot, sour, and sweet. All four lists stay.
origin: The Thái table in Sơn La. Bảo tàng tỉnh Sơn La, 21 March 2020. Vietnam.vn, 2 April 2024. Báo Sơn La, 4 September 2020. Vietnamnet, 16 March 2019.
taste: Báo Sơn La, on 4 September 2020, names the hot smell of mắc khén and the fat, sweet fish. Vietnamnet, on 16 March 2019, calls the taste hot, sour, and sweet, and says the fish’s own taste stays. The museum handbook does not print sour.
howToEat: From the grill. The museum handbook pairs it with xôi nếp. Báo Sơn La, on 16 July 2026, pairs wet chẩm chéo with stream fish. A stall hour is Check on arrival.
where: Bản Mòng, xã Hua La, and the town table. Báo Sơn La does not name one shop. A price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Pa pinh top in Son La — grilled fish, four stuffings
seoDescription: Pa pỉnh tộp in Sơn La. The museum handbook, Vietnam.vn, Báo Sơn La, and Vietnamnet do not stuff the fish the same way. A price is Check on arrival.
